children.text: "The Reggaetón Voice" is an interactive online resource that explores how reggaetón artists use pronunciation, rhythm, and vocal style to create meaning in their music. Created by Derrek Powell, a PhD candidate in UT Austin's Department of Spanish & Portuguese, the project pairs academic research with annotated audio clips, allowing listeners to hear firsthand how linguistic features shape the genre.

title: The Reggaetón Voice by Derrek Powell
